'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Erin Winings LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Erin Winings]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''2-2'''. Several (V) boxes on this sheet are hard to read; lines whose (V) mark is unclear are left unlinked and flagged. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 2 written ''AFA'': three letters only; Anger, Fear, Aggression?; (V) box unclear; Line 5 written ''Do or do not / WA'': WA not read; Line 12 written ''Sense'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Sense; no Light Side wiki page found for Sense (V); Line 14 written ''Threepio w/ PS'': PS not expanded; Line 16 written ''Corran Horn'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Corran Horn; no Light Side wiki page found for Corran Horn (V); Line 20 written ''ivesa Gotty Gend Omy'' (V): not identified; Line 26 written ''Han, Chewie and the Falcon'' (V): no Light Side wiki page found for Han, Chewie And The Falcon (V); Line 27 written ''"'' (V?): ditto; (V) box unclear; Line 28 written ''"'' (V?): ditto; (V) box unclear; Line 29 written ''"'' (V?): ditto; (V) box unclear; Line 30 written ''"'' (V?): ditto; (V) box unclear; Line 40 written ''"'' (V?): ditto of Jedi Lightsaber; (V) box unclear; Line 41 written ''Luke strong ITF'' (V): not identified; Line 42 written ''"'' (V): ditto of line 41; Line 43 written ''"'' (V): ditto of line 41; Line 47 written ''Sorry ABTM / Blaster Def'': Def not confirmed (Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency?); Line 48 written ''"'': ditto of line 47; Line 58 ''Are u tryin to persuade me...'': struck through on the sheet; Line 59 ''WHAT'': scribbled over a struck entry, (V) ticked; no card identified; Shield 3 written ''Weapons Display'' (V?): not confirmed (reads Crepors or Weapons Display); Shield 7 written ''Affirmation'': no Affirmation page; Shield 8 written ''A Tragedy has occurred'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for A Tragedy Has Occurred; no Light Side wiki page found for A Tragedy Has Occurred (V); Shield 11 written ''Aim High'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Aim High; no Light Side wiki page found for Aim High (V); Shield 12 written ''Chasm'': not confirmed (Chasan or Chasm). Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
